row.team_price_text: Pro Account: per-seat price not published
row.evidence: Samepage's terms describe Free and per-seat Pro accounts, but samepage.io no longer publishes a pricing page or help docs (both 404), and Okta's catalogue lists SAML SSO only, so SCIM support cannot be determined.
row.notes: New in 2026-09. samepage.io now redirects to a login page; the old marketing, pricing and help pages return 404, and the only public pages are Legal and Contact Us. The terms say the Service has a Free Account and a Pro Account billed per Seat, with plan details 'under the Pricing tab' that no longer exists. Okta's OIN app (last updated March 2018) supports SAML and SWA, no provisioning. Product may be in maintenance mode; no shutdown notice found.

scim.notes: Not determinable: samepage.io now serves only a login page, Legal and Contact Us; /pricing, /features, /help, /support and /overview return 404 and no public help centre or API reference was found. Okta's 2018 OIN listing shows SAML and SWA only (no SCIM).

user_api.notes: No public developer or API documentation found.

okta.notes: OIN page (last updated Mar. 8 2018) marks SAML and SWA as checked; SCIM and all provisioning features unchecked (read from page markup).

entra.notes: Learn tutorials samepage-tutorial and samepage-provisioning-tutorial returned 404.

fallbacks.notes: No public product documentation remains on samepage.io.
